entities.summary: Pedro Diez Canseco Corbacho was a Peruvian soldier and politician who served as interim President of Peru in 1863, 1868 and 1865. He served as the second vice president from October 1862 to 1863. He was the brother of Francisco Diez Canseco, and a great-grandfather of Fernando Belaunde Terry.
